description: This file contains shell script code for testing the 'apply same filename' feature in a Git environment. It defines functions for modifying files and a series of test cases that simulate various scenarios of applying patches, including renames, overlapping changes, and reversions, to verify correct behavior of Git's patch application functionality.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: A shell function that modifies a file using sed, replacing the pattern at the first occurrence and saving the result back to the original file.
